By occasion · Housewarming

Housewarming catering menus

A housewarming is a morning function, and the spread usually follows it — idli, dosai, ghee pongal and vadai with fresh chutney and hot sambar, served to a house full of relatives before the day gets long. For families who sit their guests down to a meal, the full banana-leaf sappadu is here too. From 30 guests for a tiffin spread and 50 for a full meal, and every set below is customisable, including Jain and no onion-garlic.

18 sets · every dish listed below · all customisable, including Jain and no onion-garlic.
